stem: What do the speaker’s comments in lines 15 through 19 of the poem “Simply Me” suggest?
instruction: Use “Simply Me” to answer the following question.

options.label: A
options.text: The speaker thinks that she has been treated unfairly by others.

options.label: B
options.text: The speaker hopes that others will notice the changes she has made.

options.label: C
options.text: The speaker feels that her past mistakes were not errors after all.

options.label: D
options.text: The speaker believes that she should accept herself as she is.
